finding.description: Translated source banks preserve a recognizable correct numerical role. Seed 829013 offers [2,3,4,5,6] for a rank question; choosing the second-largest value gives 5 without using the dimensions or supplied nullity. This consecutive-bank rank shortcut succeeds on 34/34 control instances. The broader target/gap lookup answers every delivered control and all five batch questions. UI shuffling does not remove it.
finding.reproduction: Run the package CLI with --difficulty easy --seed 829013 --count 1. Complete record: minimal-shortcut-record.json. Native acceptance is recorded under minimal-shortcut-seed-829013 in grader-input.json and grader-report.json. Run regression_tests.py GeneratorRegressions.test_rank_consecutive_bank_does_not_fix_correct_role for a strict failing regression.
finding.requested_change: Change the family-wide distractor construction so recognizable bank shapes do not fix the correct numerical role. Preserve explicit source replay, introduce counterexamples to these cue rules, and regenerate the five-question batch. More translations or option shuffling alone cannot fix this.

finding.description: The package supports 11 source banks while the current source supplies 14. Missing q-141221, q-142482 and q-141190 cannot replay through any supported profile. Minimal case q-141221 requires a 4×5 matrix with rank 4, nullity answer 1, and complete bank {0,1,2,4,5}.
finding.reproduction: Run verify_source_banks.py; missing-bank-exhaustion.json records every eligible-profile trial at the original parameters. Run regression_tests.py GeneratorRegressions.test_all_current_source_banks_replay for a strict failing regression.
finding.requested_change: Add complete replay support for all three current source cases, preserving prompts, banks, correct values and solution stages. Keep their generated extensions subject to the independent shortcut regression.

reason.summary: Two demonstrated defects: answer-bank patterns bypass the intended reasoning, including all five delivered batch questions; three current source banks are unsupported. Package unchanged; no database writes or asset publication.

source_analysis.skill: Find rank or nullity using rank(A) + nullity(A) = number of columns.
reasoning_steps: Identify the supplied and requested dimensions.
Subtract the supplied dimension from the column count.
invariants: Rank must lie between zero and min(rows, columns).
Preserve easy, one-step substitution and the five-choice radio response.
permitted_variations: Vary feasible dimensions and supplied values.
Vary distractors and correct numerical roles without introducing extra prerequisites.
source_refs: tutorial 0728c510-110b-5bde-93ea-9050a87a6ecc: rank(A)+nullity(A)=n, where n is columns

source_replay.details: 11 of 14 source questions replay completely. No supported profile reproduces the three missing complete banks.

math.details: Independent checks verified feasibility, subtraction, choices and worked solutions for 269 sampled/batch records and ten controlled records.

variety.details: Both targets and varied shapes survive delivery, but three observed bank profiles are omitted. Decision shortcuts are assessed separately.

scope.details: Supported outputs retain easy rank-nullity substitution. Unsupported difficulties and invalid response types reject explicitly.

grading.details: Native grader: 83 accepted, 164 rejected, zero unresolved. Tests include complete choice banks, counterfactuals, normalized batch records and the exact shortcut example.

rendering.details: All 15 actual-UI previews pass. Inspected screenshots show readable notation, shuffled radio controls and worked solutions.

packaging.details: Relocation and deterministic replay pass. Exact dependencies match Python 3.13.5 and sympy 1.14.0. Manifest and declared package files remain byte-identical.

decision_variation.details: Target word plus sorted option gaps predicts 264/264 raw controls, 257/257 delivered controls and 5/5 surviving batch questions, versus 20% guessing. Conditional signature probes are also perfect. Counterfactual dependencies pass. Selection analysis has explicit policy/history limits. Captured inventory contains only original source questions, so no stored generated instances were affected.
